release_id.conversion_and_null_policy: Documentary candidate only: L+--sha256-+H(I.hash_inputs). Production approval changes tier bytes/fingerprint; new release, same stable record identities.

raw_json.source_locator: entire associated normalized row + origins + referenced source cells
raw_json.conversion_and_null_policy: Lossless envelope {origin: first origin or null,row: complete row,columns: source headers or null,values: source row/cells or null,supplemental: all origins/raw/context}. Keep unknown fields and immutable retained bytes; never map unknown keys to invented SQL columns.

entity_kind.conversion_and_null_policy: office here; future kinds need typed record locator.

upstream_namespace.conversion_and_null_policy: nvi.hu:territorial-code:<office_type>; namespace qualification prevents council/mayor collisions.

upstream_id.conversion_and_null_policy: Exact county or county-settlement code; never unqualified municipality name.

reason.conversion_and_null_policy: Source alias only, no historical successor claim. Incomplete refresh cannot create deletion edge.

lineage_id.conversion_and_null_policy: country-package-hungary; exact lineage owner, never latest-publication alias.

attempt_id.conversion_and_null_policy: attempt-+lowercase randomUUID for each actual attempt; absent from release fingerprint. No real attempt row in pack.

operator.conversion_and_null_policy: Actual operator; do not invent Justin action.

script_version.conversion_and_null_policy: Actual version when implemented, not documentary adapter claim.

started_at.conversion_and_null_policy: ISO UTC start persisted before staging work.

finished_at.conversion_and_null_policy: NULL while running; real UTC finish on terminal transition.

status.conversion_and_null_policy: Exact attempt-log enum started/succeeded/failed. Failed attempt survives discarded stage. No success asserted here.

input_inventory_json.conversion_and_null_policy: Exact attempted descriptors incl tiers/overrides/versions; retain failed attempted hashes.

successful_release_id.conversion_and_null_policy: NULL on failure/in-progress; same release ID allowed across unchanged new attempts.

publication_set_json.conversion_and_null_policy: All lineage members, not Hungary alone; unrelated citation ownership unchanged.

row_counts_json.conversion_and_null_policy: Attempt facts including accepted/rejected scopes; documentary counts not runtime proof.

error_text.conversion_and_null_policy: NULL on success; failure reason on rejection/rollback. Do not erase durable failed-attempt evidence.
